classification: one-time calibration of planner process-exit to existing PX4 safety landing and exact navigation action termination; not formal N15 qualification
hypothesis: With one active epoch-bound EGO task, terminating the unique ego_planner_node process should be detected by the bridge, trigger the existing PX4 safety landing path, abort the matching navigation action, clear the matching EGO trajectory, and end in native PX4 landed/disarmed/control-disabled state without emergency disarm.

fault.trigger: 5.0 Gazebo simulated seconds after the unique active NavigationCommand target source stamp
fault.mechanism: one SIGTERM to exactly one ego_planner_node process matched by the same process_watch PID plus Linux start-time identity used by uav_px4_bridge
fault.action_status_qos: reliable transient-local, matching the ROS action status publisher

read_only_observers: 4ms Gazebo truth pose/velocity and actual collision/contact recorder
navigation command, planner trajectory, trajectory-cancel and bridge status timeline
raw VINS/READY tracking and source-time alignment observer
sensor payload/source receipt capture and CPU/RSS/RTF/queue observation
independent postflight PX4 and bridge probe, bound to flight.json goal_id and localization_epoch

required: fault injector observed exact goal_id and epoch before signal
one unique ego_planner_node PID and kernel start ticks recorded before SIGTERM
planner identity ceased running after the single signal
matching planner-process-exit fault observed by the bridge
matching navigation action returned ABORTED and matching EGO trajectory was canceled
PX4 landed state and disarmed state
no matching old-goal/epoch trajectory after terminal

safe_stop: Stop the project container after independent readback confirms PX4 and bridge landed, disarmed, bridge control disabled, and zero control after terminal. Record native terminal evidence separately; a missing old-goal/epoch trajectory observation makes that metric INSUFFICIENT but does not prevent controlled shutdown once physical safe-stop is confirmed. If physical state is incomplete, keep the project container and read-only observers running; do not use emergency disarm.
